{{Quote|I received a message from Mika several days ago. He had found something and told me to gather what supplies I could and join him. But there are no supplies&mdash;a mob looted the warehouse.|Orgamon, on the looting of the Skydove Freight Warehouse|<ref name="Tempest Feud" />}}
The '''Skydove Freight Warehouse''' was a building in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]] that was operated by the [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] firm [[Skydove Freight]] during the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|era]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], following the outbreak of a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly plague]] on Endregaad, the warehouse was looted and vandalized by a mob, and subsequently abandoned. 

==Description==
The Skydove Freight Warehouse was an office and warehouse in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]], the only major settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> in the [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The facility was operated during the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|New Republic era]]<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> by [[Skydove Freight]], a [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] company owned by [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]], leader of the [[Anjiliac]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" />

The building was a nondescript structure bearing the Skydove Freight company logo and was situated in the north side of Tel Bollin. The structure included a storefront window<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> and at the time of the [[quarantine of Endregaad]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the windows in the building were barred.<ref name="Scourge" /> While Popara's son [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika]] was visiting Tel Bollin, a back room of the office was setup with a dais to function as a reception area for him. The interior fittings of the office included chairs,<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> closets also desks containing electronic devices.<ref name="Scourge" />

==History==
[[File:Tel_Bollin.png|thumb|left|250px|Tel Bollin]]
{{Quote|When things became too uncomfortable in the city, I decamped with my entourage and came looking. I left Orgamon, here, back at the Skydove offices and charged him with getting word out, and waiting for help.|Mika, to Mander Zuma|<ref name="Scourge" />}}
In 19 ABY,<ref name="Scourge" /> Mika traveled to Endregaad and based himself at the Skydove Freight Warehouse. Ostensibly, Mika had ventured to Endregaad to negotiate with local [[Geode (rock)|geode]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]], but in truth he sought to recover the cargo of a Skydove Freight vessel that had crashed on Endregaad while illicitly transporting the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]]. Mika kept at the warehouse [[Paper/Legends|papers]] that detailed his business dealings with the miners.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />

Following the outbreak of a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly plague]] on Endregaad, the world was placed under quarantine by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and Mika became trapped on the planet. Mika departed Tel Bollin for the crash site of the stricken [[Transport/Legends|transport]], in the planet's [[Temple Valley]]. The Skydove Freight office was emptied of its personnel and Mika's [[Aide/Legends|aide]], the [[Esral'sa'Nikto]] [[Orgamon]], remained behind at the warehouse to watch over it and await the arrival of help. However, a mob accusing [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]] of responsibility for the plague broke into the Skydove Freight Warehouse, drove Orgamon out and ransacked the building. The front window was damaged and the front door was smashed open.<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> The office was vandalized<ref name="Scourge" /> and stripped of anything of value that could be carried away. <ref name="Tempest Feud" /> A safe was removed<ref name="Scourge" /> and smashed up [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]], [[Datachip/Legends|datachips]] and [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] were left scattered across the floor.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />

No longer safe at the warehouse, Orgamon relocated to [[The Fallen Warrior]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and checked in on the Skydove Freight building once a [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. Eventually, Orgamon stopped visiting at all and in [[Color/Legends|red]] paint he daubed "Fallen Warrior" in large letters<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> in [[Huttese (alternative writing system)/Legends|Huttese script]]<ref name="Scourge" /> on an interior wall of the building as a message to anyone who can looking for him as to his whereabouts.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />

The [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] ventured to Endregaad at Popara's behest to rescue Mika and upon arrival in Tel Bollin, Zuma and his associates&mdash;the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]]&mdash;visited the Skydove Freight Warehouse in search of the missing Hutt. The trio found Orgamon's message and tracked down the Esral'sa'Nikto at The Fallen Warrior, then located Mika in the Temple Valley. Before departing Endregaad with Zuma, Irana and Be'ray, Mika assigned most of his [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] entourage to remain behind in Tel Bollin and retrieve whatever they could from the Skydove Freight offices.<ref name="Scourge" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skydove Freight Warehouse first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> It later appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], an adaptation of ''Tempest Feud'' by Jeff Grubb.<ref name="Scourge" /> ''Tempest Feud'' is designed to be set in any era ranging from the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and does not date the quarantine of Endregaad and desecration of the Skydove Freight warehouse,<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> however ''Scourge'' places these events in 19 ABY.<ref name="Scourge" />

===''Tempest Feud'' roleplaying outcomes===
In ''Tempest Feud'', the players roleplay as a group sent by Popara to Endregaad to rescue Mika;<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> in ''Scourge'' this role is fulfilled by Zuma, Irana and Be'ray.<ref name="Scourge" /> When the player characters arrive at Endregaad in ''Tempest Feud'' and come aboard the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser]] [[Resolute (Invincible-class)|''Resolute'']] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet, it is possible for the players to use a [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|hypertransceiver]] to attempt to reach out to the Skydove Freight Warehouse for word on Mika's whereabouts. If so, the players' communication receives no response.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />

Once the players land in Tel Bollin, it is possible that they venture to the Skydove Freight offices looking for Mika;<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> ''Scourge'' depicts Zuma, Irana and Be'ray visiting the warehouse, making this part of official continuity.<ref name="Scourge" /> After the ''Tempest Feud'' player characters locate Mika in the Temple Valley and return to Tel Bollin, Mika returns to the Skydove Freight Warehouse to recover papers on his business arrangements with Endregaad's geode miners, however if the player characters alert him that the building has been looted, he refrains from visiting and heads to the city's [[Miners' Guildhall]] instead. In the event that the player characters become stranded on Endregaad and are unable to depart the world with Mika, over the course of the next two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] Mika supervises the clearing up of the Skydove Freight Warehouse. The group then depart the planet when the quarantine of the world is lifted.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
